name: Racetrack
description: Winding roads made of quarter turns, each a dark band with pale lane lines at its edges and down its middle, looping and meandering across the sheet.

code.style: --rule: ( --road: @pd(@p(var(--color1), var(--color2))); --line: @pd(@p(var(--color3), var(--color4))); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { -webkit-transform: rotate(@p(0deg, 90deg)); transform: rotate(@p(0deg, 90deg)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(@var(--road)); -webkit-mask: @var(--rr); mask: @var(--rr); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(@var(--line)); -webkit-mask: @var(--rl); mask: @var(--rl); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --rr: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 0, transparent 26%, #000 26% 74%, transparent 74%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 100%, transparent 26%, #000 26% 74%, transparent 74%); --rl: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 0, transparent 30.5%, #000 30.5% 33.5%, transparent 33.5%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 0, transparent 48.5%, #000 48.5% 51.5%, transparent 51.5%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 0, transparent 66.5%, #000 66.5% 69.5%, transparent 69.5%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 100%, transparent 30.5%, #000 30.5% 33.5%, transparent 33.5%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 100%, transparent 48.5%, #000 48.5% 51.5%, transparent 51.5%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 100%, transparent 66.5%, #000 66.5% 69.5%, transparent 69.5%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
